“The current popularity of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has even surpassed the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths…”

Several days later, on the Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan casually glanced at the changes in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path after its ‘update’ and was amazed.

Since the Starry Sea Era, the Supreme Evolution Path has always been the most popular evolutionary path in Human Civilization.

It symbolizes the ultimate in a particular evolutionary road, coveted by countless Evolvers.

...

For the vast majority of Evolvers, if they had a choice, they would definitely prioritize cultivating the Supreme Evolution Path.

The only drawback of the Supreme Evolution Path is that its upper limit is locked at Tier 11, with no chance for an Ultimate Leap.

But what of it? Tier 11 is already a goal too lofty for nearly all Evolvers to even dream of.

Compared to other evolution paths, every realm within the Supreme Evolution Path is extremely well-developed and even perfect.

In a battle between Evolvers of the same rank, under normal circumstances…

If all other aspects of their abilities and foundations are equal,

the one who cultivates the Supreme Evolution Path will be stronger by quite a few notches.

Hence, the popularity of the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths in Human Civilization is beyond doubt.

However, Lin Yuan could clearly feel now,

that the frequency of discussions about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path on the virtual network has surpassed the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths.

This is not to say that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has outstripped the Supreme Evolution Path.

Rather, in more than two million years, no other evolutionary path has managed to reach a level just below the Supreme Evolution Path at the Tenth Rank.

If Tenth Rank could already overwhelm Tier 11, what would happen when the Martial Path Evolutionary Path advances to Tier 11?

As a result,

countless Evolvers in Human Civilization speculate that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path might possibly become Human Civilization’s tenth Supreme Evolution Path.

“The tenth Supreme Evolution Path?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, as he had no certainty of crossing into the Ultimate,

Once failed, even with the protection of the Door to the Myriad Realms, he didn’t know if he would survive.

“The number of people practicing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has started to surge dramatically in the past few days.”

Lin Yuan called up the specific data for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and started watching it seriously.

“First Tier Chapter: Twenty-six trillion.”

“Second Layer Chapter: Eight hundred thirty-two billion.”

“Third-Rank Chapter: Four billion.”

“Fourth-Rank Chapter: One hundred twenty billion.”

“Fifth Stage Section: Fifty-three million.”

“Sixth Rank Chapter: Eight hundred sixty thousand.”

“Seventh Rank Chapter: Seventeen thousand.”

“Eighth Layer Part: Zero.”

…

“A hundred years have passed, and not a single Martial Arts Evolutionary has entered the Eighth Layer?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Compared to more than a hundred years ago, the number of practitioners in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s First Tier Chapter to the Fourth Rank Chapter has increased by thousands to tens of thousands of times.

The Fifth Stage Section to the Seventh Rank Chapter also increased by several hundred to a thousandfold.

But as for the Eighth Layer… at least for now,

no Eighth Layer Martial Path Evolutionary has registered their realm.

“Time is still too short.”

Lin Yuan shook his head inwardly, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path hasn’t even been around for five hundred years since it was uploaded.

Even with enormous potential, it can’t be converted immediately into a final number of High-Rank Evolvers.

The evolution of life is a long process, even with a specific Evolutionary Path to guide it.

“It seems I still need to spend time creating more, video analyses from the Seventh-Rank Peak to the Eighth Layer…”

Lin Yuan reflected thoughtfully.

Although it isn’t specified, the higher the number of High-Rank Evolvers in his Evolution Path, the better for his Ultimate Leap.

After all, as the progenitor of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, Lin Yuan doesn’t have to worry about later Martial Path Evolvers posing a threat to him,

In fact, any Martial Path Evolver, regardless of their realm or bloodline, would naturally be suppressed by Lin Yuan.

“In over a hundred years, the revenue from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has already exceeded six hundred billion Cubic Universe Crystals…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face,

Hundreds of years ago, he was worried about a few thousand or tens of thousands of Cubic Universe Crystals,

Now, his net worth has skyrocketed to be calculated in billions of Cubic Universe Crystals.

“But high revenues also mean substantial costs in cultivation.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself quietly,

So far, his main expense in cultivation

comes from one of the three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, the “Xuanhuang Physique.”

“Xuanhuang Physique” itself was a method fleshed out by infinite resources,

Adding to that Lin Yuan’s formidable physical foundation, the enhancement of the Mysterious Gourd, the boost from the Eternal Spring, the amplification of Martial Dao, the infusion from the Chaos Void Origin, and so on.

As a result, even a slight enhancement of Lin Yuan’s physical strength requires tremendous sacrifices.

And the enhancement of “Xuanhuang Physique” to the body depends on its original strength,

Leading to the cost of cultivating this secret technique many times exceeding Lin Yuan’s expectations.

After all, when Lin Yuan first obtained this secret technique, he never anticipated that his physical foundation would be greatly enhanced again under the Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

…

“I can vaguely sense those life forces cultivating the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, as if they’re guided by some inexplicable force…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes and focused intently.

If one were to picture an expanse of darkness surrounding Lin Yuan at the center,

Then at this moment, numerous points of light like fireflies began to emerge, each one seemingly feeble when seen alone.

But in number, they were vast, spreading out as far as the eye could see, like a wildfire spreading through the night.

“Could these all become the ‘booster’ for my Ultimate Leap?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, these sparks of light were not limited to the Main Universe; some came from distant places too vague to ascertain.

They were likely the life forces of Martial Dao Cultivators who had spread the Martial Arts to other dimensions during past travels.
